edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded into the Deposit event in the payable fallback.
onlyWallet modifier requires msg.sender == address(this) before replaceOwner body runs.
ownerExists modifier requires isOwner[msg.sender] || msg.sender == delayedOwner.
ownerExists modifier gates confirmTransaction entry.
ownerExists modifier gates executeTransaction entry.
confirmations[transactionId][msg.sender] = true records the caller confirmation.
msg.sender == delayedOwner branch selects the delayed confirmation path.
block.timestamp decides whether the delayed owner confirmation is stored.
now is the base of the now + 2 weeks deadline computation.
Computed deadline is written to delayedConfirmations[transactionId].
confirmed modifier compares delayedConfirmations[transactionId] < now before execution.
isConfirmed uses now to decide whether the delayed confirmation counts.
executeTransaction forwards destination, value and data into the low-level external call.
The external call lets the callee re-enter the wallet, including executeTransaction.
txn.executed is set to true before the external call to block re-execution.
On a failed call the executed flag is reset to false after the external interaction.
notExecuted modifier reads transactions[transactionId].executed to guard re-entry.
